2. Commit the changes to the repo

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Copy workflow file to VPS
c.exec_command("mkdir -p /opt/areloria/.github/workflows")

# Write workflow
workflow = '''name: Android Build & Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'client/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v2
      - name: Build Debug
        run: cd client/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
      - name: Build Release
        run: cd client/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: arelorian-apk
          path: |
            client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
            client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk
'''

sftp = c.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/android.yml', 'w') as f:
    f.write(workflow)

c.exec_command('cp /tmp/android.yml /opt/areloria/.github/workflows/android.yml')

# Show APK info
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -lh /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk")
print("APK:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
